```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(fixest)
library(patchwork)
library(stargazer)
library(nlme)
library(plm)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(pscl)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(margins)
library(car)
library(effects)
```



```{r reading}

pitching <- read.csv("pitching_2015_2024.csv")


#selecting only pitchers with more than 50 IP because they are most likely starters and will have the most consistent data
pitching_selected <- pitching[ pitching$IP > 50, c("WHIP", "ERA", "HR.9", "Age", "K.9", "Team", "Season")]



```



```{r}
model1 <- lm(ERA ~ WHIP, data = pitching_selected)
summary(model1)
model2 <- lm(ERA ~ WHIP + HR.9, data = pitching_selected)
summary(model2)
```


```{r}
anova(model1, model2)
```
```{r}
model3 <- lm(ERA ~ WHIP + HR.9 + K.9, data = pitching_selected)
summary(model3)
anova(model2, model3)

model4 <- lm(ERA ~ WHIP + HR.9 + K.9 + Age, data = pitching_selected)
summary(model4)
anova(model3, model4)
vif(model4)
```
```{r}
model5 <- feols(ERA ~ WHIP + HR.9 + K.9 + Age | Season, data = pitching_selected)
summary(model5)
```

```{r}
p_ols <- plm(ERA ~ WHIP + HR.9 + K.9 + Age, data = pitching_selected, model = "pooling", index = "Season")
p_fe  <- plm(ERA ~ WHIP + HR.9 + K.9 + Age, data = pitching_selected, model = "within", index = "Season")

phtest(p_fe, p_ols)

```
